description: Dependency-update policy for RacingBettingSyndicate. Renovate creates and maintains dependency PRs. Patch updates are automerged once required checks pass; all other updates require manual review and merge.

packageRules.description: Keep automerge disabled by default for all dependency updates. A later, narrower rule enables it only for eligible patch updates.
Automerge patch updates once all required CI checks pass, including 0.x dependencies. Minor and major updates keep automerge disabled. Relies on GitHub required status checks.
Pin Docker image tags to an immutable SHA256 digest as well as their human-readable tag/version where the registry supports digests.
tommye123/racingbettingsyndicate-* are this project's own published images, not third-party dependencies. Renovate should not manage them.
